source_tokens.text: "CLAIM-006 (origin: trust vault PvE thesis, 2026-08-18): a node's value to the network equals the entropy difference it creates - H(unframed) minus H(framed), measured in bits per time over the same underlying referent. Nodes that reduce entropy for the network survive and compound; nodes that increase or merely rearrange entropy are outcompeted. Framed entropy is cheaper for the network to evaluate than unframed entropy of the same thing. Falsifiers: a node that removes bits is not retained by the network; a node is retained while increasing network entropy; or the framed version of a thing costs more bits to evaluate than the unframed version"

source_tokens.text: "A baseline layer positions humans against entropy (PvE) rather than against each other, so the competitive reference is unframed entropy itself. Participation is voluntary and rewarded across multiple overlapping systems, so no single system's failure is fatal to the network's retention of energy. The system survives while overlapping rewards keep voluntary participation above the entropy baseline and above the participant's outside option"
